/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from openlibrary.catalog.marc.marc_binary import MarcBinary
from openlibrary.catalog.marc.parse import read_edition
base = Path('openlibrary/catalog/marc/tests/test_data')
for stem in ('880_Nihon_no_chasho', '880_arabic_french_many_linkages'):
    expected = base / 'bin_expect' / f'{stem}.json'

    parsed = read_edition(MarcBinary((base / 'bin_input' / f'{stem}.mrc').read_bytes()))
    data['authors'] = parsed['authors']
    expected.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\\n')
PY
python -m pytest openlibrary/catalog/marc/tests/test_parse.py -q"
